title: 3dHist
description: Computes histograms using functions for generating priors

dind_subbrick.description: Use sub-brick SB from the input rather than 0
dind_subbrick.title: Sub-brick number

mask_dset.description: Provide mask dataset to select subset of input.
mask_dset.title: Mask dataset

mask_range.description: Specify the range of values to consider from MSET. Default is anything non-zero
mask_range.title: Mask range

cmask.description: Provide cmask expression. Voxels where expression is 0 are excluded from computations.
cmask.title: Cmask expression

hist_file.description: Read this previously created histogram instead of forming one from DSET.
hist_file.title: Histogram file

prefix.description: Write histogram to niml file called PREF.niml.hist
prefix.title: Output prefix

equalized.description: Write a histogram equalized version of the input dataset.
equalized.title: Equalized output

ignore_out.description: Do not count samples outside the user specified range.
ignore_out.title: Ignore out of range samples

range_hist.description: Use previously created histogram to set range and binwidth parameters.
range_hist.title: Range histogram file

at_val.description: Set the value at which you want histogram values.
at_val.title: Histogram value at

get_params.description: Return the desired properties at a given value. You can select multiple properties.
get_params.title: Histogram parameters to get

voxvol.description: Specify voxel volume in mm^3. To be used with upvol.
voxvol.title: Voxel volume

val_at.description: Return the value where histogram property PAR is equal to PARVAL. PAR can be: cdf, rcdf, ncdf, nrcdf, upvol.
val_at.title: Value at histogram property

quiet.description: Return a concise output to simplify parsing.
quiet.title: Quiet output
